meta.note: Values copied as written in app.css (light :root, dark [data-theme=dark]). Tokens marked 'refactor' are new, for the ribbon workspace.

tokens.name: axpo-water-a
tokens.usage: Left end of the Axpo gradient: the 2px rule under the top bar, the active-tab indicator, the step numbers, the Quick predesign button. Same in both themes; never as text on dark.

tokens.name: axpo-water-b
tokens.usage: Right end of the Axpo gradient. Never as text (1.6:1 on white) and never as a fill behind text other than on-brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the Axpo gradient (brand mark, Quick predesign button): 7.2:1 on axpo-water-a, 1.6:1 on axpo-water-b, so keep labels on the left half or over the blend.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selection tints (8–15 % mixes behind txt), hover borders, the opacity slider, swatch of the access category. Not for text on panel in light (3.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: The filled accent of the light theme and the PV table symbol; the dark theme fills with accent instead (see fill).

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: The one filled accent per theme: primary buttons, armed tools, 2D / 3D chips, the step bubbles. Text on it is on-fill.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on fill: 7.2:1 on accent-strong (light), 8.5:1 on accent (dark).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and marks: links, the active tab, selected tools, focus rings, the avatar initials. 7.2:1 on panel and bg in light, 7.5:1 on panel in dark.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: the tab strip, panel footers, chips at rest.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Top bar, ribbon, floating panels, cards, menus, toasts, map controls.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inputs and selects.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover of buttons, rows and tools; the ground of kbd, pills and plain notices.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel and input borders, ribbon group separators, table rules. Decorative only (1.3:1), never a control's only boundary.

tokens.name: txt
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, panel, field and hover: 17:1 light, 15:1 dark.

tokens.name: mut
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, hints, group labels, the status bar, on bg and panel: 5.0:1 light (on bg), 5.4:1 on panel; 7.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done: the dot of a status line, the tab bubble of a finished step (with on-ok), the rule of a success toast. Never as text (2.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: on-ok
tokens.usage: The number inside a done step bubble: 7.7:1 on ok, in both themes.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings: the rule and 12 % tint of a warning notice behind txt, the stale pill, the CRS badge border. Never as text in light (2.5:1).

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Errors: the rule and 10 % tint of an error notice behind txt, the × of a row on hover. The source's danger button sets white on it at 3.9:1 (kept exact; keep that label bold and short).

tokens.name: cat-gross
tokens.usage: Map category Gross area: the site boundary outline and its layer swatch (categories.js).

tokens.name: cat-net
tokens.usage: Map category Net area: the buildable boundary.

tokens.name: cat-connection
tokens.usage: Map category Grid connection route: the cable route to the point of connection, dashed until confirmed.

tokens.name: cat-exclusion
tokens.usage: Map category Exclusion zones, hatched, with their buffers.

tokens.name: cat-linear
tokens.usage: Map category Linear infrastructure: power lines, pipelines, ditches, with their corridor.

tokens.name: cat-obstacle
tokens.usage: Map category Obstacles: trees, poles, buildings.

tokens.name: cat-access
tokens.usage: Map category Access & grid connection point: gates and the connection point.

tokens.name: cat-mitigation
tokens.usage: Map category Mitigation: hedges and green screens.

tokens.name: cat-agri
tokens.usage: Map category Agricultural zones.

tokens.name: cat-reference
tokens.usage: Map category Reference: cadastral parcels and anything shown but not used.

tokens.name: table
tokens.usage: PV tables and trackers on the map and in the layer swatch; the fill of the selected row count.

tokens.name: table-edge
tokens.usage: Module lines and edges of the PV table symbol over the table fill (refactor).

tokens.name: road
tokens.usage: Perimeter and internal roads on the map (refactor).

tokens.name: fence
tokens.usage: The perimeter fence, dotted, on the satellite basemap (refactor).

tokens.name: slope-1
tokens.usage: Slope class 0–5 % (the .legend ramp of app.css).

tokens.name: slope-2
tokens.usage: Slope class 5–10 %.

tokens.name: slope-3
tokens.usage: Slope class 10–15 %.

tokens.name: slope-4
tokens.usage: Slope class 15–25 %.

tokens.name: slope-5
tokens.usage: Slope class over 25 %.

tokens.name: slope-cut
tokens.usage: Hatch of the cells cut by the slope limit of the structure, over slope-cut-soft.

tokens.name: slope-cut-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the slope-cut hatch.

tokens.name: map-chrome
tokens.usage: Opaque ground of the scale bar, north arrow, legend and attribution over imagery, in both themes (refactor).

tokens.name: on-map
tokens.usage: Text on map-chrome (13.6:1) and map labels, with a 3px map-chrome halo (refactor).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring, 2px outside every control (inset on inputs): 7.2:1 on panel and bg in light.

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: Panel copy, inputs, buttons, the body default of app.css.

styles.name: text-strong
styles.usage: Project name, section titles, selected values.

styles.name: text-small
styles.usage: Ledger rows, inline fields, the save state.

styles.name: text-hint
styles.usage: Hints, notices, status lines, layer names, small ribbon tools.

styles.name: text-tool
styles.usage: Captions under the large ribbon tools: two lines at most.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Stacked form labels, uppercase (label.l in app.css).

styles.name: text-overline
styles.usage: Ribbon group labels, ledger group headings, pills and eyebrows, uppercase.

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: The brand, panel and dialog titles, step titles.

styles.name: text-kpi
styles.usage: KPI values and the ledger total, tabular digits.

styles.name: text-metric
styles.usage: The one key figure of the active tab in the ribbon context, tabular digits.

styles.name: text-data
styles.usage: Coordinates, CRS codes, scale and elevation in the status bar and on the map chrome.

tokens.name: space-05
tokens.usage: Gaps between stacked small tools and chip rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its caption; vertical rhythm inside tools.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons and chips, ribbon padding (app.css .btns gap).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between KPIs and fields; padding of list rows and KPIs (app.css).

tokens.name: space-25
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of cards, sections and ribbon groups (app.css .card).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel body padding, insets of floating panels over the map, top-bar gaps.

tokens.name: space-35
tokens.usage: Top-bar and status-bar horizontal padding (app.css #top).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, gaps between status-bar items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing in the brand book and the cover insets.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: kbd, small icon buttons, swatches, map chrome.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, ribbon tools, toolbar buttons (app.css .btn).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: KPIs, lists, toasts, map controls, the selection chip (app.css .kpi, .list, .toast).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, sections, floating panels, menus (app.css .card, .sec, .mapcard).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs (app.css dialog.dlg).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, step bubbles, the Tools button.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The sticky results bar (app.css .sticky).

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Map controls, the 2D / 3D chips, the Tools button (app.css .fab, .mapchips).

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers (app.css .toolsmenu).

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Floating panels over the map and toasts (app.css .mapcard, .toast).

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs (app.css dialog.dlg).

gradient.note: The Axpo gradient as app.css writes it. Components build it from axpo-water-a and axpo-water-b, so a theme that moves the ends moves the gradient.

tokens.name: axpo-gradient
tokens.usage: The 2px rule under the top bar, the active-tab indicator, the Quick predesign button, the target bar fill.
